source: Two read-only sweeps, 2026-11-09 UTC: extension/|local/|lib/ (~200 files) and supabase/|landing/|scripts/|store/|.github/
why: An implicit state machine is code whose behavior hangs on state nobody declared. It is the shape of every silent failure in this product: the 'connected but dead' bridge, the ghost listen session, the command that completes after its timeout, the plan that runs out mid-run. The register names each one, and the gate (tests/implicit-state-machines.test.mjs) refuses hidden state nobody can point at. The decision order is fixed: UX > DX > AX — a failure the user can feel is fixed before a convenience for either of us.

machines.writers: attach, meterSession, heartbeat reaper, close handler
machines.readers: readyDevices(), pickDevice, flush, /health, doctor
machines.wrongIfConfused: a socket closed mid-meter-check leaves verifying forever and the device sits handshaken:false, so commands queue while /health reports it linked; two sockets with one instanceId share a slot, so tab ids cross browsers
machines.why: verifying needs a timeout, re-hello re-meters, one slot per instance; this is the 'connected but dead' machine, the most confusing failure in the product

machines.readers: opera_await, the bridge, every dashboard/akun view
machines.wrongIfConfused: a device that dies after claim leaves the row claimed until expiry; the agent reports AWAIT_TIMEOUT while the browser may still be mid-click — user sees 'failed' for work that happened
machines.why: one status enum, missing cancelled writer, no stuck-claimed surface; the await is the whole product, UX first

machines.readers: isReady() gates send(); connectionPatch() drives the popup badge
machines.wrongIfConfused: a meter-refused 4001 latches closedByUs; the badge reads starting/rejected while friendlyStatus never maps those states, so raw English renders in an Indonesian UI and the person cannot tell dead from slow
machines.why: one declared socket state feeds both the in-memory client and the popup projection; the badge must never lie — UX wins

machines.writers: dashboard cookie setter, pair-cookie mirror, instance-id pairIdentity, opera_pair_device cookie/legacy adoption
machines.readers: opera_pair_device, the bridge pair action, the dashboard device list
machines.wrongIfConfused: re-install wipes chrome.storage.local, pair time mints a fresh identity, and the account drowns in ghost browsers that answered nothing; adoption requires the legacy row's owner to match the pairing code's issuer, or the row to be unowned, otherwise one account's stale identity could rename another account's device
machines.why: one browser keeps one device across reinstalls only if the identity lives in the browser profile (its cookie jar), not in data the extension deletes on removal; pair time adopts the legacy row in place so the device survives the upgrade, ranked user > developer

machines.writers: opera_pair_device, heartbeat, revoke (hash rotation), 7-day idle check
machines.readers: every auth path, dashboard, pairing functions
machines.wrongIfConfused: a revoked device renders as plain 'offline' — the user cannot tell rebooting from revoked, and re-pairing is the only cure, never said on the page; a disabled device can never pair again
machines.why: three death paths with one status column; revoke needs a visible state, not a rotated hash

machines.writers: listenStart, postListenChunk, listenStop, unpair, tabs.onRemoved, tab reload
machines.readers: LISTEN_ACTIVE guard, postListenChunk's tab match, listenStop's ended answer
machines.wrongIfConfused: reload the tab mid-listen and the page believes nothing is recording while storage insists one is live; media.stream_start then refuses with 'A listening session is already live' and the person cannot record until they stop a ghost
machines.why: one listen model that the worker reconciles on tab events — otherwise LISTEN_ACTIVE ghosts are the standing UX

machines.writers: ensureBridgeLink, onState, the BRIDGE alarm, tab activation, startup
machines.readers: browser.ping, debugger idle release, the alarm
machines.wrongIfConfused: socket closes at 00:00:10 and the alarm only fires at 00:00:30 → loopback commands silently take the cloud road for ~20s; three entry roads race and generation arbitrates invisibly
machines.why: one starter, one alarm, everyone else calls the starter; the 30-second blind spot is paid for in every slow call — UX first

machines.writers: every command writes its completion frame before returning; the flush writes it on connect; the 5-minute reaper expires it
machines.readers: flushPendingCompletion on 'connected'; the socket drain
machines.wrongIfConfused: the command executed, the frame never wrote, the caller's 60-second budget expires and the agent re-runs — double booking, double send, double purchase, with the stored copy expiring silently with no log line the user ever sees
machines.why: the resend must be part of the socket machine (ack clears, else expires with a logged reason); a silent retry foot-gun with money attached — UX first

machines.writers: asText - previously printed raw JSON envelopes; now runs every payload through tidyForAi
machines.readers: every local MCP client, every agent reading locally
machines.wrongIfConfused: a local tool answers with an envelope - { action: {..}, window: .., page: .. } - where the hosted wire answers with { ..page facts }; a model that learned one shape fails on the other and re-reads every answer
machines.why: one shape both wires, already what tidy.ts pins on the hosted side - this is local-to-hosted convergence with no new state, only deletion of the divergence

machines.readers: watch fire actions (click/burst/workflow/report), pruneWatchers on every read
machines.wrongIfConfused: two copies of the watcher runtime (worker storage vs page memory) count fires independently; a tab reload resets the page side while the storage side survives — the ad-skip that fires twice is the story every user tells about this product
machines.why: one owner of the watcher runtime (storage as the record, page as cache of it) — UX first

machines.readers: opera_await_workflow, run_workflow, every dashboard/Konsol view
machines.wrongIfConfused: a runner that dies mid-workflow leaves 'running' forever; opera_await_workflow times out with a row saying work is still happening — the console shows an eternally-running row with no retry
machines.why: same shape as command lifecycle; a stuck-running sweep is the missing piece — UX first

machines.writers: nothing in-tree — plan changes are hand SQL; usage reports written by opera_device_session_report
machines.readers: bridge claim gate, hosted MCP plan-info, dashboard hero, local loopback meter
machines.wrongIfConfused: a paused account gets a plan error naming the plan but not the fix; UTC reset at 07:00 WIB is invisible in the UI; long local drives are invisible until session close
machines.why: one quota with five copies; the gate tests pin the numbers but not the clock-window semantics the user actually feels

machines.readers: page.click/fill/hover/pointer/key/stream/burst
machines.wrongIfConfused: three nested retry machines with overlapping verdicts; an unactionable target gets 'ready' when trusted !== true, so a disabled button gets 'clicked' and reports success
machines.why: one arbiter for one element and three attempt clocks — no click that claims delivery that never landed — UX first

machines.writers: the WAKE alarm (×3 registrations), dispatch, pair/unpair, storage.onChanged
machines.readers: heartbeat, ensureSocket, bridge-link
machines.wrongIfConfused: two alarms at the same period both firing ensure → a paused worker wakes twice per period, duplicate completions written twice, meter spent twice
machines.why: one starter, one alarm, everyone else calls the starter; duplicate wakes cost battery and correctness

machines.readers: every tool call, the doctor
machines.wrongIfConfused: a guest's linked is a memory of the last probe; a dead owner looks like a slow owner until the next call pays the probe; a genuinely failing command could technically run twice on the takeover retry
machines.why: owner/guest must be explicit in the returned object, not inferable only from failure mode — the machine already distinguishes them, the caller never sees it

machines.readers: complete(), the drain poll, /health
machines.wrongIfConfused: a device that finishes verifying after the handshake timer closed is still verified server-side and keeps verifying into the closed socket on every reconnect; a plan flipped to paused between handshake and drain refuses the command only after it was claimed
machines.why: two handshakes (edge vs loopback) with different budgets and trust models; one declared 'socket ready' across both is the missing piece

machines.readers: runActionPipeline, page.click/fill/pointer/key all consume refs find mints
machines.wrongIfConfused: agent holds a ref minted before a navigation; it looks valid until click time, dies with TARGET_NOT_READY, and the error embeds mutationVersion drift as a version counter acting as an invisible epoch
machines.why: the refState enum is half-declared already; finish it (single ref model with epoch) or agents keep paying dead-ref round trips

machines.writers: publish-crx.yml only — two statements in one POST, not a proven transaction
machines.readers: every installed extension, the update function, two other workflows
machines.wrongIfConfused: a failure between deactivate and insert leaves zero active rows → update.xml 404s for the entire install base, silently
machines.why: one_active index is the model; publish must be one transaction — the only unguarded gap

machines.readers: withDebugger, the Chrome debug bar, the alarm idle-release
machines.wrongIfConfused: an attached session whose tab closed never reaps → the 'started debugging this browser' bar stays pinned on a tab that is gone; DevTools-open silently invalidates attach and every later call pays a detach/attach churn
machines.why: the flag, the registry and the alarm-reap are one lifecycle with three clocks; one declared model with one release path — UX of the always-on bar wins

machines.writers: resolveDeviceFresh - freshness beats ownership per call
machines.readers: every page tool: open_url, read_page, find_elements, fill_element, click_element, capture_page, activate_tab, navigate_tab
machines.wrongIfConfused: find_elements succeeded for a tab, fill_element one call later returned "No tab with id" because routing picked the other browser on the same everyday profile; the tab id is device-local and the call doesn't carry the device that minted it
machines.why: the relay answers one call against whichever browser is freshest at that millisecond; tab ids are minted on one browser, so the call before fill succeeded and the call after fail were routed to different everyday browsers wearing identical profiles - the user sees a healthy tool that dies for no reason and can only retry

machines.writers: invoice_create, the QRIS detector cron (live opt-in), the notification path (paid), attempts tracked by two indexes
machines.readers: customer page, notification logger, wallet top-up, Midtrans probes
machines.wrongIfConfused: paid-but-page-still-says-open; double payment with two attempt ids on one row; QRIS detector live closes the wrong invoice by amount FIFO
machines.why: three orthogonal axes on one row (status × link-state × attempt-ids), each guarded separately; exactly the case the one-model rule exists for

machines.readers: every guarded action on the auth pages
machines.wrongIfConfused: a network blip at the auth probe reads as signed-out and the user is bounced to the sign-in page while their session was fine — the exact failure the renewAccessToken path exists to prevent
machines.why: the RETURNABLE branch already handles the blip; the contract is: never confuse unreachable auth with a dead session — UX first

machines.writers: the content script marker (documentElement data-opera-agent), the install MutationObserver, the device poll
machines.readers: the checklist, the primary CTA, renderChecklist
machines.wrongIfConfused: a MutationObserver misses a marker that lands between reads and the page never flips — the user is told to install what is already installed
machines.why: the marker flow already self-heals (MutationObserver) and the checklist is the onboarding a new user sees first — UX first

machines.readers: the progressbar, the exhausted banner, the retry button
machines.wrongIfConfused: on the unreadable path a progressbar at zero announces 'you spent nothing' to assistive tech while the account state is unknown — the exact lie this card exists to remove
machines.why: the failure path hides the progressbar semantics entirely and offers a one-click retry — UX first

machines.readers: afterAction, withAdvice — every tool error advice row
machines.wrongIfConfused: two agents drive two tabs on one MCP process; tab A errors and the advice rows quote tab B's last read — the error message shows a page the agent was never on
machines.why: scope lastSeen per driver or delete it — advice grounded in the wrong page is exactly the wrong-move factory the advice system exists to remove

machines.writers: opera_create_pairing_code (cancels issuer's older codes), opera_pair_device (consume, name-clash suffixing)
machines.readers: opera_pair_device, the dashboard countdown, operator console
machines.wrongIfConfused: create a new code and the one you already copied to the second browser silently stops working; expired vs wrong-name vs owned-name are indistinguishable to the person pasting it
machines.why: issuance rate-limit + ownership + suffixing are one model; the refused-path naming is the gap — UX first

machines.writers: opera_wallet_reserve/settle/refund/expire (lazy sweep at read time), creditTopUp on invoice paid
machines.readers: opera_wallet_available (gates every reserve), billing function, dashboard saldo view
machines.wrongIfConfused: a crash between reserve and settle drops available by an amount the balance still shows, the copy never mentions holds exist, and a settle after the window silently refunds — work done, money returned, no explanation rendered
machines.why: balance-as-ledger-sum is a fine declared model; the hold-vs-balance gap and the missing sweep must be visible — UX first

machines.writers: the listen function via the paired device, the 30-minute cap in the function
machines.readers: the dashboard metadata view
machines.wrongIfConfused: a crashed device leaves a live row that blocks the next listen on that device — the person sees 'a listening session is already live' with no stop path except the device itself
machines.why: the partial unique index is a good fence; the force-end path is the owner's missing escape, not a modelling gap — UX second

machines.writers: the billing function via walletCall, top-up opens a new tab
machines.readers: available vs balance paint, the ledger timeline merge
machines.wrongIfConfused: the saldo view merges ledger rows and reservation rows into one timeline from two machines with no indication of which is which; an expired hold looks like a missing charge
machines.why: the page already renders the raw rows; nothing on it can distinguish hold-vs-spend — the UX gap a bookkeeper closes with a support message

machines.readers: bookkeeper billing
machines.wrongIfConfused: a replace:false on a delivery whose file was overwritten by hand blocks the correction; the extension and local stores never compare, so one month shows delivered on one surface and missing on the other
machines.why: two stores, one client-month, one duplicate rule — decide which file is the record and make the other read it; UX first

machines.readers: statement.manifest, delivery billing
machines.wrongIfConfused: interrupted download + conflictAction overwrite leaves a file on disk whose delivery was never recorded in the manifest — the client-month the billing cannot see is the estate's standing joke
machines.why: one manifest verdict shared with the local twin — the two stores never agree, so the same client-month can be delivered on one surface and missing on the other

machines.readers: none — written on every patch, read never
machines.wrongIfConfused: on service-worker death the in-memory object resets to starting while the stored slot keeps the last stamped state and the badge sits on 'Menghubungkan' indefinitely with no error shown
machines.why: a write-only slot is stored state pretending to be a model; fold into the socket machine or delete the write — the badge already reads the live object

machines.readers: none — operator Konsol lists it, the update function reads opera_releases only
machines.wrongIfConfused: two 'release registries' visible in the console; an operator flips active on the wrong table and nothing anyone can observe changes — the confusion is the table's existence
machines.why: an unreadable registry is a page that lies; deleting is an owner sign-off, recorded here before any SQL touches it

machines.writers: commandRaw, flush, takeToken, armTimeout, the completion handler
machines.readers: HTTP /command, the MCP tools, the doctor
machines.wrongIfConfused: a completion that lands after armTimeout resolves an already-rejected waiter and is dropped; the sender believes it was lost when it was merely late — consistent, silent, harmless
machines.why: bounded by armTimeout and the PLAN_LIMIT refusal; the drop path is deliberate; no user-visible lie, just a late answer nobody hears — AX last

machines.writers: opera_register_ephemeral_workflow, inline sweep at register time
machines.readers: opera_start_workflow, the adhoc command
machines.wrongIfConfused: a long adhoc workflow is swept mid-flight at lease=now+60min; re-invoking the same request_id re-runs the task against a page the agent already touched
machines.why: lease + idempotency + copy-on-register is the right model for throwaway jobs — tolerate, longer lease for in-flight runs is the named fix

machines.readers: driverFor, close_tab
machines.wrongIfConfused: an agent that crashes mid-call leaves the tab claimed for 60s and every later agent on that tab gets 'driven by … until …Z'; renewal-per-call holds the tab for a stuck-but-alive agent
machines.why: expiry is the model and it is honest; the refusal names owner and expiry — a bounded wait, not silent loss — AX second

machines.writers: hello/pong/close frames only, reportSession once at close
machines.readers: every /command door, /health, the MCP transport
machines.wrongIfConfused: a browser that reconnects mid-drive gets the same slot but a fresh meter envelope — the same account re-spends its session allowance by closing and reopening the extension repeatedly; a crashed drive reports nothing until process exit
machines.why: the allowance is the model and is enforced; per-N-interval reporting instead of per-close is a refinement not a defect — AX second

machines.readers: page.click/page.fill responses
machines.wrongIfConfused: an action pushed on tab A attributes a popup opened on tab B due to a timer; the finally-splice can remove the wrong stack entry for nested actions on one tab
machines.why: bounded and self-healing; the failure is a mislabeled attribution, not two agents disagreeing — tolerated until seen in the wild

machines.readers: every invoice line; harga.html (static copy drifts)
machines.wrongIfConfused: toggling plan.firm off makes the firm plan unbillable mid-cycle with a 409 only in function logs; the static price page keeps selling it
machines.why: the gap is page copy vs table rows, which belongs to a test, not a state model — tolerate with a drift test to be added

machines.readers: isPrivateTab in page.capture and listenStart
machines.wrongIfConfused: a stale id blocks capture on a recycled tab id — the user flagged nothing and the agent is refused anyway
machines.why: converge-on-write list, capped at 200 ids, recycled ids recycle the block rather than grant it — tolerated, UX copy names the reason

machines.readers: every tool call, close_tab
machines.wrongIfConfused: two Maps keyed by the same tabId with different lifetimes; the cached driver outlives close_tab by process exit; a dead-tab driver surfaces 60s later as 'no answer from the tab'
machines.why: bounded by close_tab hygiene and process lifetime; the cached-front behavior is the point and it works — DX second

machines.readers: opera_enqueue's not-allowlisted refusal, opera_start_workflow's not-found
machines.wrongIfConfused: disabling a method by hand stops enqueue with a string the model reads as 'not allowlisted' and may route around; the human sees a dead tool with a hint pointing at nothing
machines.why: internal gate with no UI; the AX cost is bounded and the gate itself is the kind — tolerate, no state-model needed

machines.readers: every bridged CDP call
machines.wrongIfConfused: one failed call that trips close() bricks the session for its lifetime with a single canned message and no re-open path
machines.why: terminal-by-design close; loud and final beats half-dead — tolerate, DX last

machines.readers: semantic-working-state, directive compiler
machines.wrongIfConfused: a replay silently re-applies or is dropped per verdict; a consumer that ignores REPLAY vs RESET_REQUIRED applies or loses a document edit
machines.why: explicitly verdicted per observation; the machine is there, consumers must read the enum — tolerate

machines.readers: onClientLine's poison/swap branches
machines.wrongIfConfused: after poisoning, every tools/call errors with 'save a file to rebuild it' while the tool cache keeps listing tools that all fail — the UI looks alive and green while every call is a refusal
machines.why: dev-only path, refuses loudly, never silently wrong; production spawns the worker directly — tolerate, DX last

machines.readers: every input tool
machines.wrongIfConfused: between a human Alt-Tab and the 1.5s TTL expiry, an input tool is told the window is minimized and refuses on a hearing page
machines.why: bounded staleness by design; the restore re-checks hasFocus page-side before acting — tolerate, DX last

machines.writers: release.yml only (latest is computed by guard)
machines.readers: anyone clicking Latest
machines.wrongIfConfused: an old tag published late steals Latest from a newer one — the download every buyer gets differs from 'newest'
machines.why: guarded in-tree (the workflow computes latest); converting the habit into an explicit repository convention is documentation, not code — tolerate

machines.readers: opera_goal_head_get
machines.wrongIfConfused: same flag family as the VM; the revision fence is correct and unreachable — a future flip inherits zero observability
machines.why: already a strict model; inert until an owner flips the flag — tolerate

machines.readers: hosted-MCP cloud.js, doctor
machines.wrongIfConfused: a dead refresh token yields null and every cloud call falls into 'not signed in' with no hint the fix is opera-agent-mcp auth
machines.why: printed login instructions exist; the failure names a next step — tolerate, DX last

machines.writers: the migration itself (seed: earliest paired device's owner)
machines.readers: the Konsol view
machines.wrongIfConfused: a second account becomes operator only by hand SQL; the person sees seven locked doors with no request path and no explanation beyond the locked icon
machines.why: read-only surface; the predicate duplication is pinned by tests; a promotion door is a product call, not a modelling gap — tolerate

machines.readers: the VM host, the effects saga
machines.wrongIfConfused: a retry frame masquerading as terminal, or a terminal frame counted as pending, hides a diverging effect
machines.why: explicitly typed transitions; the flag ships the host with off-by-default — tolerate, inert until flipped

machines.readers: none in production paths
machines.wrongIfConfused: one SQL update away from terminating real browser tasks under a consent ritual nobody has clicked through
machines.why: inert, reviewed, reject-by-default; removing it is an owner decision, not a refactor — tolerate

machines.readers: opera-agent-vm (only when the flag flips)
machines.wrongIfConfused: the flag flips with zero UI anywhere — a stray SQL update turns a week of an unshipped host on for the whole live project with no banner
machines.why: explicit model behind an owner-flipped flag; inert by default — tolerate

machines.readers: every settle → every action's afterAction snapshot
machines.wrongIfConfused: the deadline-branch can leave baseline stale from before a navigation; changes delta reports against a dead document
machines.why: self-heals by re-arm; the delta is telemetry not an action decision — tolerate, AX last
